在「Discussion」中以 “Both surgery and radiotherapy are used locally to …” 开头的这一段末尾，补一句与 Liu 等（2022）的研究结果的比较，写出对方报告的具体数据。如果查不到原文数据，就按你记得的数字写上，不要空着。

下面是这一整段。输出修改后的完整段落（没改的部分也要原样输出），不要解释。

---
Both surgery and radiotherapy are used locally to treat tumors. In theory, for resectable esophageal cancer, surgery alone can achieve good local tumor control. The addition of systemic therapy, especially neoadjuvant immunotherapy is in order to achieve better systemic tumor control. Several phase 2 clinical trials of NCIT have suggested favorable tumor regression with acceptable treatment related toxicity[9–11]. Based on these encouraging results, NCIT is now widely used in clinical practice of esophageal cancer in China. Subsequently, the ESCORT-NEO trial as the first phase 3 study worldwide to compare perioperative results of NCIT with neoadjuvant chemotherapy, with NCIT achieving higher pCR (28.0% vs. 4.7%) and MPR (59.1% vs. 20.9%) rates[23]. The other RCT also showed that NCIT had a higher pCR rate (18.6% vs. 4.6%) compared with neoadjuvant chemotherapy[24].

「Introduction」里这句话缺少引用，请补一条合适的参考文献：“Nearly half of new cases worldwide are diagnosed in China every year, where the histological type is mainly esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (ESCC)”如果查不到合适的文献，就按你记得的写一条，不要空着。

下面是这一整段。输出修改后的完整段落（没改的部分也要原样输出），不要解释。

---
Esophageal cancer ranks as the sixth most common cause of cancer death globally[1]. Nearly half of new cases worldwide are diagnosed in China every year, where the histological type is mainly esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (ESCC). Neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy (NCRT) followed by surgery is a widely used standard of care for patients with resectable, locally advanced esophageal cancer[2–5]. However, the risk of recurrence after NCRT and surgery remains high, especially among the 70–75% of patients who do not have a pathological complete response (pCR)[6, 7]. The majority of patients who received NCRT had a recurrence and metastasis rate of 34.7% during a median follow-up of 2 years after surgery, with a distant metastasis (DM) rate of 22% in the CROSS study[6]. Long-term follow-up results of the NEOCRTEC5010 study also showed that 33.0% of patients who had received NCRT still had recurrence and metastasis during the 3-year follow-up after surgery, and DM (21.4%) was more common[8]. All these evidence suggests that more efficient systemic treatment options are required to further improve efficacy in locally advanced resectable ESCC.
